_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written from scratch.
name: Icecast
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Icecast is an internet radio server that takes audio from streaming software such as BUTT, Mixxx or Liquidsoap and serves it to listeners. The egg installs Xiph's own build and writes its config with random passwords at install.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Icecast: downloads Icecast from Xiph's own Debian 13 repository, and the
# Debian 13 libraries it needs that the server's image doesn't have, each
# checked against the checksum in its repository's package index, into
# icecast/. icecast.xml is only written on the first install (with random
# passwords); after that it's the owner's, like the logs.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

xiph=https://download.opensuse.org/repositories/multimedia:/xiph/Debian_13
debian=https://deb.debian.org/debian
# Libraries Icecast (and libtheora, which links cairo) needs beyond those
# in Raptor's Debian image.
libs="libogg0 librhash1 libspeex1 libtheora0 libtheoradec1 libtheoraenc1 libvorbis0a libvorbisenc2 libxml2 libxslt1.1
    libcairo2 libpixman-1-0 libx11-6 libxcb1 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libxext6 libxrender1 libxau6 libxdmcp6"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "Icecast has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

tmp=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$tmp" .raptor-old && mkdir -p "$tmp"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp" .raptor-old' EXIT
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$tmp/xiph" "$xiph/Packages" || fail "Xiph's download site can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
# pkg <index> <name>: "<filename> <sha256> <version>" of a package for this CPU.
pkg() {
    awk -v p="$2" -v a="$arch" '
        /^Package: / { n = $2; v = ""; ar = ""; f = ""; s = "" }
        /^Version: / { v = $2 } /^Architecture: / { ar = $2 } /^Filename: / { f = $2 } /^SHA256: / { s = $2 }
        /^$/ && n == p && (ar == a || ar == "all") { print f, s, v; found = 1; exit }
        END { if (!found && n == p && (ar == a || ar == "all") && f != "") print f, s, v }' "$1"
}
read -r ice_file ice_sum ice_version < <(pkg "$tmp/xiph" icecast2) || fail "Xiph's repository has no Icecast for this CPU right now."
version=${ice_version%-*}
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$want" = latest ] || [ "$want" = "$version" ] || fail "Icecast $want can't be downloaded: Xiph's repository has only the newest release. Set Version to latest, or to $version."

read -r igloo_file igloo_sum _ < <(pkg "$tmp/xiph" libigloo0) || fail "Xiph's repository has no libigloo for this CPU right now."
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$tmp/debian.xz" "$debian/dists/trixie/main/binary-$arch/Packages.xz" || fail "Debian's download site can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
xz -dc "$tmp/debian.xz" > "$tmp/debian"
rm -f "$tmp/debian.xz"
want_list="xiph $ice_file $ice_sum
xiph $igloo_file $igloo_sum"
for p in $libs; do
    line=$(pkg "$tmp/debian" "$p")
    [ -n "$line" ] || fail "Debian 13 has no $p for this CPU, which Icecast needs."
    want_list+=$'\n'"debian ${line% *}"
done
stamp=$(sha256sum <<<"$want_list" | cut -d' ' -f1)

if [ -x icecast/bin/icecast2 ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-icecast 2>/dev/null)" = "$stamp" ]; then
    echo "Icecast $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Icecast $version and its libraries"
    mkdir -p "$tmp/debs" "$tmp/root"
    while read -r from file sum; do
        base=$xiph; [ "$from" = xiph ] || base=$debian
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$tmp/debs/p.deb" "$base/$file" || fail "The download of ${file##*/} failed. Reinstall to try again."
        [ "$(sha256sum "$tmp/debs/p.deb" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "The download of ${file##*/} didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        dpkg-deb -x "$tmp/debs/p.deb" "$tmp/root"
    done <<<"$want_list"
    new="$tmp/icecast"
    mkdir -p "$new/bin" "$new/lib" "$new/share"
    mv "$tmp/root/usr/bin/icecast2" "$new/bin/"
    mv "$tmp/root"/usr/lib/*-linux-gnu/* "$new/lib/"
    mv "$tmp/root/usr/share/icecast2" "$new/share/"
    # The package links some web and admin pages to /etc/icecast2: put the
    # files themselves there instead.
    find "$new/share" -type l | while read -r l; do
        t=$(readlink "$l")
        case "$t" in /etc/icecast2/*) rm -f "$l"; cp -r "$tmp/root$t" "$l" ;; esac
    done
    cp "$tmp/root/etc/icecast2/icecast.xml" "$new/share/icecast.xml.default"
    [ ! -e icecast ] || mv icecast .raptor-old
    mv "$new" icecast
    echo "$stamp" > .raptor-icecast
fi
mkdir -p logs

# The shipped config's passwords are all hackme. On the first install,
# write icecast.xml with random ones, Icecast's files in icecast/, the logs
# in logs/ and the error log on the console.
if [ ! -f icecast.xml ]; then
    gen() { head -c 15 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '/+='; }
    source_pw=$(gen) relay_pw=$(gen) admin_pw=$(gen)
    share=/home/container/icecast/share/icecast2
    sed -e "s|<source-password>[^<]*</source-password>|<source-password>$source_pw</source-password>|" \
        -e "s|<relay-password>[^<]*</relay-password>|<relay-password>$relay_pw</relay-password>|" \
        -e "s|<admin-password>[^<]*</admin-password>|<admin-password>$admin_pw</admin-password>|" \
        -e "s|<basedir>[^<]*</basedir>|<basedir>$share</basedir>|" \
        -e "s|<logdir>[^<]*</logdir>|<logdir>/home/container/logs</logdir>|" \
        -e "s|<webroot>[^<]*</webroot>|<webroot>$share/web</webroot>|" \
        -e "s|<adminroot>[^<]*</adminroot>|<adminroot>$share/admin</adminroot>|" \
        -e "s|<reportxmldb>[^<]*</reportxmldb>|<reportxmldb>$share/report-db.xml</reportxmldb>|" \
        -e "s|<errorlog>[^<]*</errorlog>|<errorlog>-</errorlog>|" \
        icecast/share/icecast.xml.default > "$tmp/icecast.xml"
    grep -q "<source-password>$source_pw<" "$tmp/icecast.xml" && grep -q "<admin-password>$admin_pw<" "$tmp/icecast.xml" ||
        fail "Icecast's default config has changed, so the install can't set its passwords. Reinstall to try again later."
    chmod 600 "$tmp/icecast.xml"
    mv -f "$tmp/icecast.xml" icecast.xml
    echo "Sources connect with the password $source_pw; the admin page's user is admin, with the password $admin_pw. Change them in icecast.xml."
fi
echo "Installed Icecast $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Icecast version to install: latest, or the newest release by its number, such as 2.5.0.
